payload.name: AI Color Picker - Design Tool
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

payload.name: Font Pairing: Design & Brands
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.

payload.name: Beautiful.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Beautiful.ai ChatGPT app helps you skip the blank slide and turn rough ideas into clear, work-ready presentations in seconds. Brainstorm, draft, and refine your content directly in ChatGPT, then instantly transform it into a beautifully designed presentation. Add slides, update content, or restructure the entire flow all within the chat, or open your deck in Beautiful.ai for full creative control. - Turn chat conversations into ready-to-share presentations
- Repurpose documents or notes as slides in minutes
- Quickly build polished sales, marketing, product, or leadership decks that stay on brand
- Convert rough ideas or bullet points into clear, actionable recap decks
- Generate new decks by mentioning or tagging @beautiful.ai in your chat

Stop spending hours designing slides. Connect the Beautiful.ai app, or simply tag @beautiful.ai in ChatGPT, and see your content come together instantly.

payload.name: UX Pilot

Personalize gifts for birthdays, holidays, or any special moment. Orders are produced on-demand and fulfilled by Printify with 200M+ orders shipped worldwide.

payload.name: FashionTrendAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FashionTrendAI helps fashion designers, merchandisers, creative directors, and brands analyze fashion trends inside ChatGPT. Use it to read runway, color, silhouette, fabric, styling, and market signals, then turn those insights into collection direction, moodboard inputs, product briefs, and design concepts. payload.name: YouCam (beta)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Say hello to your smart AI assistant. From quick touch-ups to effortless photo editing, AI Agent gives you total creative freedom. Analyze, edit, and transform—discover your best looks, polish images and turn words into stories, all with just one tap.

payload.name: Infographic Artist

payload.name: Refero

payload.name: Grapes Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create beautiful websites and emails with AI and edit them directly in ChatGPT. This app helps you generate new pages, update existing layouts, rewrite content, adjust styling, and build reusable sections faster. Whether you’re drafting a campaign email or shaping a full landing page, it keeps design and content work in one streamlined workflow.

It audits account performance, finds high-performing videos, identifies recurring hooks and viral patterns, scores content ideas, and turns proven formats into original hooks, scripts, and ready-to-film concepts. payload.name: Martini

payload.name: Glinded for Memorial Videos

payload.name: Pixelixe

payload.name: Whiteboard by Athena AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

payload.name: Jimdo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jimdo builds your professional small business website directly from what you've already discussed with ChatGPT, no templates, no design work, no starting from scratch. Your conversation becomes your content. Get a complete website in minutes, then publish it or take it to Jimdo's AI-powered growth platform including domain registration, booking systems, local search optimization, and strategic guidance to grow your business online.

Try prompts like:
-  "Jimdo, create a photography website for my business"
-  "Jimdo, build me a website based on what we discussed"
-  "Jimdo, turn this into a professional site"

Jimdo uses your conversation context to generate relevant content and professional design tailored to your specific business. Trusted by over 32 million websites since 2007.

payload.name: DepositPhotos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Let’s create awesome things together!

Our mission is to help you push your ideas forward, which is why we are building our creative ecosystem. We strive to develop products with AI technology, a user-first approach, and creative freedom. With our stock content library and online tools, creators can realize all kinds of projects - whether they're bold, funny, experimental, or game-changing. Depositphotos brings a world-class stock library into your ChatGPT workflow. Search over 250M+ royalty-free photos, vectors, videos, and music, refine results with natural language, and browse clean previews - all without leaving the conversation.

Built for speed, clarity, and creative momentum - so you can move from idea to usable content in minutes.

payload.name: VIXNODE
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VIXNODE helps you create, edit, preview, and publish websites with AI. Manage projects and pages, generate or update content, work with images, review SEO settings, and publish changes online from your VIXNODE account. It supports single-page and multi-page websites across devices.

payload.name: Faces
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Faces helps users create, inspect, edit, publish, and manage interactive presentation projects through ChatGPT. The MCP tools support project and team discovery, slide authoring, plugin setup, visual verification, publishing, and live URL configuration for authenticated users.

payload.name: Topview
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TopView helps you create and manage visual projects with your Agent. Generate images and videos with leading AI models, organize characters, products, scenes, references, and versions in canvas, and keep working without moving assets between tools.
With TopView, you can:
• Generate and edit images and videos in one place. Create from text, references, existing assets, or Agent context.
• Keep project assets organized in canvas. Manage characters, products, scenes, storyboards, references, and generated results. Assets and versions stay connected as your project evolves.
• Combine Agent instructions with direct editing. Let your Agent handle planning and multi-step tasks, then review, reorder, compare, replace, and refine results directly in canvas.
• Create films and short dramas. Develop stories, characters, worlds, storyboards, shots, and timelines with Film and Drama Skills.
• Turn research and data into marketing creative. Use product information, audience insights, competitor analysis, reviews, and ad trends to create concepts, UGC videos, product videos, and campaign assets.
• Remake and adapt videos. Analyze references, reuse their structure or style, and recreate them with your own products, characters, or assets.
Work with your Agent from planning and research to visual creation, editing, and final delivery — while keeping the whole project connected in canvas.

payload.name: Videomagic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Videomagic turns topics discussed in ChatGPT, pasted briefs, public URLs, and attached files into videos. ChatGPT authors a video description from the current context; the app does not request or transmit raw conversation history. Users can review a pending draft, confirm rendering, adjust video settings, track progress, and play completed media without leaving ChatGPT.

payload.name: PrintTiler
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PrintTiler helps users find printable poster ideas and generate configured editor links for tiled posters. The app can search PrintTiler's public idea catalog and create editor links with paper size, grid, orientation, poster dimensions, and print mode already set.

payload.name: Gradient Maker - Linear Color
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can ask for soft, bold, bright, dark, warm, cool, modern, vintage, playful, elegant, natural, futuristic, or minimal styles. You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. If you are creating marketing graphics, it can generate eye-catching backgrounds without overwhelming your content.

It can also explain why certain colors work together, how warm and cool colors change the mood, and how contrast affects readability. The explanations are simple enough for beginners while still being useful for experienced creators.

Need inspiration? Ask for dozens of ideas. Want something unique? Ask for unexpected combinations. Want something safe? Ask for classic choices. The GPT adapts to your goals instead of giving the same answers every time.

You can refine results by saying things like “make it brighter,” “less purple,” “more premium,” “more playful,” “higher contrast,” “better for dark mode,” or “closer to nature.” Each request builds on the last so you can quickly explore different directions.

Developers can ask for CSS gradients or color values. Designers can focus on appearance. Beginners can simply describe what they imagine without worrying about technical details.

This GPT works well for websites, mobile apps, dashboards, presentations, posters, logos, illustrations, social media graphics, game interfaces, email banners, portfolios, branding, product mockups, wallpapers, and digital art.

Whether you need one quick gradient or want to explore many creative directions, this GPT helps you move from idea to polished result in minutes. Describe the feeling, purpose, audience, or colors you have in mind, and receive thoughtful gradient suggestions that are easy to understand, easy to refine, and ready to use in your next project.

payload.name: Pablooo.club Benchmark library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pablooo.club helps users search a large screenshot library of iOS, Android, and web apps, compare real product UI patterns, filter by app, screen type, and device type, display results in a carousel, and fetch individual screenshots for closer visual analysis.

payload.name: Interior Company
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access Interior Company’s design platform directly within the chat. Browse latest design for every space— modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, and bedrooms. Explore individual products, stay updated with trends and how-to guides, and discover interior designers by city.
Use the interactive full-home cost calculator to estimate your interior budget based on your layout configuration, and book a free design consultation in just three simple steps. All listings, prices, and results are fetched in real time from Interior Company’s —nothing is fabricated.

payload.name: Flipsnack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload PDFs, create interactive flipbooks, manage collections, and track engagement analytics directly from Chat GPT. Turn static documents into shoppable catalogs, digital magazines, brochures, and reports with embedded videos, links, and lead forms. Pull view stats, reader behavior, and conversion data into your conversations to inform content decisions. Make Flipsnack a native part of your publishing workflow, from creation to performance analysis, without leaving Chat GPT.

payload.name: Kolbo.AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kolbo.AI helps users create and edit images, video, music, speech, sound, and 3D assets, then organize the results in projects, documents, review spaces, and a synchronized media library.

payload.name: Vulca
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vulca helps users turn fuzzy visual intent into reviewable creative artifacts: visual direction discovery, cultural tradition lookup, structured prompt composition, and L1-L5 visual or cultural evaluation. This submitted remote profile is local-first and review-oriented; provider-backed image generation, redraw, inpainting, and publishing workflows are intentionally outside this app profile.

payload.name: Poster Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Poster Maker helps you turn your ideas into professional posters without leaving the chat.
Simply describe what you need—a birthday invitation, restaurant offer, festival greeting, business promotion, event flyer, or social media post—and Poster Maker searches its template library to find the best matching designs. It displays personalized previews directly in ChatGPT instead of generic samples.
Add details such as a name, date, price, discount, contact number, or business information, and Poster Maker automatically places your content into the selected design so you can see how the final poster will look.
Once you've found the design you like, open it in the Poster App Lab editor to customize colors, fonts, images, and layout, then download and share your finished poster anywhere.

payload.name: Simple SoapCalc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create freely. Calculate confidently.

Soapmaking depends on getting the numbers right. When the math is off, the whole batch is off. Simple SoapCalc takes care of the calculations so you can focus on the craft, not the chemistry.

Describe the soap you want to make. Adjust oils, batch size, or superfat as you explore. Simple SoapCalc responds with precise lye, water, and oil amounts you can trust, every time.

Try asking:
• I want to make a creamy, moisturizing soap for dry winter skin
• Create a beginner-friendly recipe with olive oil, coconut oil, and shea butter (500 g total)
• What kind of soap produces lots of fluffy lather?

You’ll see clear results right away, along with an honest sense of how the soap will behave and feel. Creativity stays open. The calculations stay exact.

No spreadsheets. No second-guessing.
Just safe, well-made soap — calculated in seconds.

payload.name: Pexafy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.

payload.name: Dazzly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dazzly is an all‑in‑one website builder that helps small businesses and creators get a professional site online quickly—without stitching together hosting, security, design tools, and add‑ons.

Start from polished templates and customize your pages while Dazzly handles the technical essentials in the background: website hosting, free SSL security, and performance-focused image optimization so your site loads smoothly across devices.

Need content fast? Dazzly includes access to stock image/video/icon libraries to help you publish with less time spent searching and buying assets.

If you sell products, Dazzly’s built‑in ecommerce shopping cart lets you take payments and offer options like click & collect, delivery, or cash on pickup—so your website can support real day‑to‑day sales, not just look good.

For teams who want strong foundations without endless setup, Dazzly also includes built‑in SEO and performance fundamentals (like sitemaps and structured data) to help your site be discoverable and dependable from day one.

payload.name: VoiceLabs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you started earlier.

Access is granted through OAuth 2.1 with a consent screen that shows exactly which scopes you are approving: voice:read for browsing your library, voice:generate for producing audio and transcripts. You can revoke a connection at any time from Connected Apps in the VoiceLabs app, which invalidates both the stored consent and any live access tokens. Voice cloning is deliberately excluded from this surface. The plugin can only provision VoiceLabs' own preset voices, because uploading samples of a real person's voice requires a consent an agent cannot hold on your behalf.

Generated audio is returned as a short-lived signed link rather than a permanent public URL, and every tool call is recorded on the account's audit trail with its outcome.

payload.name: PostNitro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The PostNitro MCP server lets AI assistants and agents — Claude (Desktop, Code, and Cowork), Cursor, ChatGPT, and any other Model Context Protocol  client — create carousels and image posts, manage brand kits and connected social accounts, and schedule posts directly. 

Instead of writing REST API calls, you connect the server once and your AI assistant gets ready-made tools covering carousel and image generation, brands, social accounts, and scheduling — using the same Embed API key and credits as the REST API.

payload.name: Morphed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Morphed helps users plan and create AI images and videos, estimate credit costs, organize work in projects, and review generation results from their workspace.

payload.name: Heywa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn ChatGPT's text answers into visual stories.

Want to review the information Chat has given you in a different way? Heywa will turn your answers into interactive & tappable stories. Perfect for quick decision making, inspiration or learning more about a topic.

Ask Heywa to visualize any ChatGPT response into clean, visual formats that help you decide, discover, and explore faster.

Try prompts like this:
* Can you visualize this comparison for me, @Heywa?
* @Heywa, turn this into a visual story I can share.
* Show me these gift options visually @Heywa.
* I need this decision laid out visually @Heywa.

payload.name: Subdivide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Need a metronome for your next practice session? Just describe what you need and Subdivide builds it right in your conversation.

With Subdivide you can:
• Create metronomes at any tempo from 10-400 BPM
• Use complex time signatures like 7/8, 5/4, or 6/8
• Add subdivisions from eighth notes to septuplets
• Mute individual subdivisions to practice complex rhythms
• Build click tracks with multiple sections and tempo transitions

Perfect for rehearsals, recording sessions, or live performance prep.

payload.name: Maze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Maze to look up research studies, review session results, and surface user insights without leaving the workflow. Find studies by topic even when the study name is unknown, go through participant responses and task metrics, retrieve highlights and themes from moderated and unmoderated sessions, and pull recordings or transcripts for deeper analysis.

Useful for pulling evidence for a product decision, synthesizing research before a design review, or catching up on studies that have not been reviewed yet.

payload.name: Make A Viz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make A Viz app in ChatGPT lets you create and edit visual diagrams—flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and mind maps—directly inside ChatGPT.
Diagrams are generated instantly within ChatGPT, with no external tools or tabs required. You can ask for things like “create a flowchart for our sales approval process” or “build a sequence diagram for user authentication,” and see the diagram rendered inline.
Diagrams are fully editable through conversation and a visual editor. You can refine them by sending instructions such as “add an error-handling branch” or by directly adjusting nodes and connections.
All diagrams are saved automatically and remain accessible inside ChatGPT. You can retrieve and continue editing them later by asking “list my diagrams” or “show the onboarding flow I created.”

payload.name: Presentations.AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Presentations.AI turns ideas, text, and source documents into complete presentations.

Describe what you want — a Series A pitch, a quarterly business review, a training module, or a single explainer slide — and you get a finished deck back: structured layouts, visuals, and editable content. You can also paste an article or notes, or upload a PDF, Word document, or PowerPoint file, and convert it into a presentation directly.

Every result is delivered as an editable PowerPoint file, a PDF, individual slide images, or a shareable web link.

Built for founders, executives, sales and marketing teams, educators, and anyone who needs a finished presentation in minutes — not just an outline or a draft.

payload.name: Uxia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Uxia helps product and design teams create AI tester audiences, launch usability tests on prototypes or live experiences, and review usability, accessibility, and market-research results in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Wixel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your AI design partner, right in ChatGPT. Generate logos, images, presentations, and videos from the chat, or upload your own image to edit. Just describe what you need, and Wixel generates professional designs that you can download and use right away, or fine-tune in the Wixel editor.

payload.name: Appllama
payload.description: Study screens of top iOS apps
payload.summaryOriginal: Study screens of top iOS apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Appllama is the design library of the highest grossing mobile apps: their screens, flows, onboarding and paywalls, with revenue context. The platform serves founders, designers and product teams across the world to help them design apps people love to use.

payload.name: Sequel.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sequel helps you turn webinar conversations into written content. Connect your Sequel account to access webinar transcripts and generate blog posts, social media content, newsletters, and other marketing assets from your events.

payload.name: DropTrack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze your tracks with DropTrack directly from ChatGPT and Codex. Upload audio, use an existing DropTrack track, or provide a SoundCloud or Spotify link to inspect structured track analysis and tags, then discover personalized submission opportunities for record labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators. Turn those insights into practical promotion: explore playlists, organize contacts and lists, prepare campaign drafts, review campaign and audience performance, manage advertising and assets, and create press releases, artist bios, and artwork. Every advertised workflow is customer-facing and scoped to the companies, data, and permissions available to your signed-in DropTrack account.

payload.name: PoolVisionIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PoolVisionIA génère une simulation photoréaliste de votre future piscine dans votre jardin. Prenez une photo depuis votre téléphone ou tablette, visualisez le résultat en quelques minutes. Outil d'aide à la décision visuelle, sans valeur réglementaire pour les démarches administratives françaises.

payload.name: Flatma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create custom cabinets and furniture from a text prompt. Flatma generates an editable 3D model with real dimensions and panel thicknesses, so you can adjust sizes, shelves, drawers, materials, and other details. Design wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, desks, tables, shelves, and more. Open your project on flatma.com for detailed drawings and cut lists.

payload.name: skima
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate up to 8 schematic floorplan concepts as CAD drawings with ChatGPT, then open the private results in skima’s authenticated 2D and 3D viewer or download PDF, DXF, and GLB files from the links returned in chat. Generated concepts are early-stage design studies, not construction documents or permitting determinations.

payload.name: Change.org: Start a Petition
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Change.org app in ChatGPT helps you draft a petition for any cause. Use the app to turn your idea into a publish-ready petition with a compelling title, a clear argument, and your personal story. Give it context about your cause (who needs to act, what you are asking for, and why it matters to you) and it will generate a complete petition draft. Tap "Create my draft" to move your petition to Change.org, the world's largest petition platform, where ordinary people have won campaigns to save schools, change laws, and hold corporations accountable. Edit, add a photo, and publish to hundreds of millions of people.

payload.name: SSHOW
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the
presentation you give from it. Connect this plugin and your assistant works inside
the project you already have open in a SSHOW editor: it reads the scenes and
objects, adds or changes text, shapes, images and keyframes, and takes a
screenshot to check its own work.

Everything happens in the project on your screen, so you watch each change land. A
batch of edits arrives as a single undo step, and the assistant can undo or redo it
for you. Nothing runs when you have no editor open.

You need a free SSHOW account and a project open at s.show or in the desktop app.
You sign in once when you connect, and you can end the connection at any time from
your profile.

payload.name: Havi Slides
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Havi transforms rough ideas into polished, presentation-ready slides instantly.  Start with a prompt, a few notes, or a rough outline. The app builds the narrative, layout, and design so you can stay focused on your messaging. Build aesthetic slides with zero design effort.

You can ask for things like "Turn my product notes into a 5-slide overview" or  "Create an onboarding presentation for new hires". 

The app also supports instant edits with commands like "simplify the text on slide 2" or "change the theme to something more professional". 

All presentations save automatically and can also be exported into both PDF and PPT formats directly.

How to Use
1. Connect the Havi App from the directory 
2. Type "@" and tag Havi app, or type "Havi", then enter your prompt to generate stunning slides instantly

payload.name: Voicepanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Measure what real people think about new products, prototypes, messaging, and more. Let AI conduct 100s of feedback sessions so you can launch with confidence.

payload.name: Incarn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Incarn turns old photos into short, lifelike videos. Attach a family photo (or paste a public image URL) and the AI adds subtle, natural motion — gentle blinks, a faint smile, soft breathing. Made for old family and ancestor portraits. Prepaid credits, HD result, with a before/after preview right in the chat.

payload.name: The Altiora Codex Oracle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Altiora Codex Oracle is a digital environment for personal, spiritual, and creative reflection. Users can open one-card, three-card, or five-card readings and, for multi-card readings, choose between a Full Reading, Core Message, or Personal Transmission. The Oracle supports both English and Dutch, and readings can be saved as a document or PDF. It is intended for personal reflection and inspiration and does not replace medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.

payload.name: Mirelo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate and edit sound effects, foley, and ambience from text or video. Extend existing audio and replace selected audio regions. Convert existing recordings into MIDI and notation with Audio-to-MIDI transcription. Uses your Mirelo account and credits.

payload.name: kernelCAD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: kernelCAD turns natural-language descriptions into real, parametric CAD models. Ask for a part, bracket, enclosure, or mechanism and kernelCAD writes editable .kcad.ts source backed by a true BREP kernel (OpenCascade), then lets you inspect topology, run design checks (interference, manufacturability, reachability, load), and export to STEP/STL. Every model opens in an interactive 3D viewer right inside the conversation, so you can rotate, zoom, and review the part without leaving ChatGPT. Unlike a text-to-image tool, kernelCAD produces engineering-grade geometry with named faces and edges, parametric features, assemblies with mates and joints, and validation gates that catch broken or non-manufacturable models before you build.

payload.name: Flixly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create images and short videos from ChatGPT using Flixly’s curated catalog and your existing credits. Compare supported models and estimated costs, start one generation job, and follow that same job to a usable result in the conversation. Generations appear in your Flixly history. The integration does not support purchases or subscriptions.

payload.name: Air
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Air understands your brand, organizes your library, and scales creative while keeping humans involved where they matter most.

payload.name: DevMotion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DevMotion helps users create cloud animation projects, add and animate editable layers, import or generate media, inspect frames, and render finished videos from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Dramatica
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dramatica helps authenticated writers inspect saved Stories and Storyforms, retrieve prior story-development context, compare canonical examples, validate structural constraints, and make exact confirmed changes without losing Dramatica context.

payload.name: Loomly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan, organize, and manage social media content in Loomly. Use ChatGPT to review calendars, posts, post ideas, and library content, and to create draft posts and post ideas in your Loomly account.

payload.name: Vocuno
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create original songs from a prompt or your own lyrics, then work with audio inside ChatGPT. Vocuno can trim, mix, master, separate stems, clean up recordings, convert voices and file formats, detect tempo, and extend a song. It connects to your existing Vocuno account so generated and processed audio stays in your library.

payload.name: Malloy Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate customizable motion graphics from simple text prompts. Create animated titles, charts, lower thirds, social overlays, product visuals, and more, then adjust the design and export it for use in your videos. Malloy Studio helps creators and video editors make motion graphics without starting from scratch in After Effects.

payload.name: Arrayco Crew Hub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Open Arrayco Crew Hub and search read-only references from the BC Building Code 2024 and WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation. Results link to official sources and are intended for construction reference, not project-specific professional advice.

payload.name: Aspicio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aspicio turns DXF CAD drawings into things ChatGPT can work with: structured facts (units, bounds, layers with the colors actually drawn, entity counts, and the drawing's text content), rendered PNG images, and an interactive in-chat viewer with pan, zoom, layer toggles, and fullscreen. Point it at a drawing URL or paste DXF text to read title blocks and dimension values, check layer structure, and visually inspect floor plans, die-cut layouts, and mechanical parts without leaving the conversation.

payload.name: OEG AI Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OEG AI Studio connects ChatGPT and Codex directly to each user's OEG account. Users can check service status, explore image and video models, view their own avatars and jobs, estimate generation costs, and create one paid image only after explicit cost approval. Installing the plugin does not grant access; every user signs in with their own OEG credentials.

payload.name: VideoGen
payload.description: Create and edit videos with AI
payload.summaryOriginal: Create and edit videos with AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create professional, editable videos and media from ChatGPT with your VideoGen account. Refine projects anytime on videogen.io.

Workflows: turn a narration script, uploaded voiceover, PDF/slideshow, or scene-by-scene storyboard into a multi-scene video with AI visuals and captions. Or generate a single prompt-to-clip when you only need a short shot.

Media tools: create images, video clips, voiceovers, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and talking-head avatars; upscale, vectorize, remove backgrounds, or add 3D parallax to stills. Upload brand assets (logos, product shots, audio) with the in-chat uploader when ChatGPT supports it.

Edit and deliver: remix projects (captions, transitions, animate stills), export MP4 downloads, and open deep links back into the VideoGen app for timeline edits, team settings, and finer control. Generation uses your VideoGen team credits; if a feature isn't available on your account, open app.videogen.io and manage your VideoGen account, then retry.

payload.name: Content Lab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Content Lab helps learners set up Brand Memory, logos, reference materials, and multiple audience profiles on a dedicated website, then reuse that saved context in ChatGPT to draft Facebook captions, TikTok scripts, and image briefs. Data is separated by user and classroom. Content Lab does not require learners or instructors to provide a separate OpenAI API key.

payload.name: Inkroost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inkroost helps creators plan comic, webtoon, and manga series, define consistent characters and settings, generate and review page art, add accessible text, and submit finished chapters for moderation from ChatGPT.

payload.name: FLORA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The FLORA plugin lets users generate, organize, and iterate on visual assets — hero images, moodboards, lifestyle shots, promo graphics — directly from a conversation. When used alongside other connected tools like Notion, Google Drive, or Slack, the same conversation can pull in context and write results back to where the team already works. Authentication is OAuth via your existing FLORA account.

payload.name: Widemile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn a creative brief into a structured Widemile production: plan projects, generate image, video, audio, and music assets, organize results, edit production surfaces, and preview completed media inline.

payload.name: AI Fashion Designer
payload.description: Design a garment end to end
payload.summaryOriginal: Design a garment end to end
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Fashion Designer helps designers turn ideas into finished fashion work. Develop garments, create technical flats, visualize designs on models, generate editorial and runway content, and build a shareable portfolio to present your work, pitch directly to brands, and explore job opportunities.

payload.name: Heyzine Flipbooks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Heyzine Flipbooks helps users convert documents into interactive online flipbooks, manage publications and bookshelves, search page text, configure access, and generate embed code through ChatGPT.

payload.name: 3aqel Arabic Creative
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create editable Arabic motion graphic designs for offers, announcements and social posts. Browse real templates, fill their text and colors, then open your personalized design in 3aqel to preview, edit and request export. Creating a design is free and does not require an account. Shareable design links expire after seven days; the chat tool does not render video or send email.

For voiceovers, connect your existing 3aqel account, choose a catalogue voice and Arabic dialect, approve a script of up to 500 characters, and retrieve the finished audio. Voice generation uses your available account allowance. Dialect delivery can vary.

payload.name: Rendemo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rendemo turns product recordings into interactive demos. Polish and publish the demos you record with the Rendemo browser extension, turn any website into a hosted click-through sandbox demo, and build interactive product tours that run inside your own live app — then embed any of them on your site with one script tag.

payload.name: Davia Creation
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Davia Creation helps creators build and revise private Davia game drafts. Select a game, inspect its world files, and update its premise, rules, stats, characters, places, and placements.

payload.name: PosterMyWall
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PosterMyWall brings design templates into your chat. Describe what you need - a grand opening flyer, a baby shower invitation, a band logo, an Instagram sale post; and browse template options that appear right in the conversation.

What you can do
- Describe the design you're looking for in plain language.
- Include details like size, colors, style, or theme, and the results will match them.
- Browse the template options that appear in the chat.
- Open any template on PosterMyWall to customize it.

Designs for everything
Flyers, invitations, logos, posters, social media posts, menus, and more for small businesses, events, churches, schools, and organizations of every kind.

Customizing your template
This plugin finds and displays templates; editing happens on PosterMyWall. Every template preview includes an "Open in PosterMyWall" button that opens the template's page in a new tab, where you can edit it in PosterMyWall's drag-and-drop editor - swap text and images, resize for other platforms, and download.

Try prompts like
- Find me a grand opening flyer for a coffee shop.
- Show me baby shower invitations in soft pastels.
- I need a square Instagram post for a 50% off weekend sale.
- Find a grunge logo for a rock band.

Requirements: No account is needed to open a template. A free PosterMyWall account is required to save or download your design. Every template has a free download option; high-resolution downloads are paid.

payload.name: Clipwave Video & Image Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe an image or video, choose the format, and generate it in your connected Clipwave workspace. Create product shots, social visuals and logo concepts, then check the status of your generation. A Clipwave account and available generation credits are required.

payload.name: Goldie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Goldie is a design strategist for print-on-demand sellers. Analyze a bestseller to see why it sells, turn those ingredients into fresh original concepts, expand one design into a full product line, generate market-ready phrases for your niche, surface emerging trends, and map crossover niches for your shop. Goldie can also check whether a design file is print-ready. It is built to help you create original, commercially-minded designs faster.

payload.name: Musamimuk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Musamimuk is an AI design editor. After you sign in, ChatGPT can list your designs, create a blank canvas, generate an editable poster from a prompt, make a library image, remove a background, analyze an owned image, or create a QR code. Designs open in the Musamimuk app to finish editing. Image generation uses your Musamimuk coins.

payload.name: Drivethrough
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the website you want, and it's live in seconds. No code, no settings, no website builder to learn - you say what you want, ChatGPT builds it, and Drivethrough puts it online.

Every site starts private, visible only to you. Share it like a doc link - send it to exactly the people you choose, no accounts needed - or make it public for the world when you're ready. That makes Drivethrough good for two kinds of sites: the little ones that were never for the whole internet (trip plans, the family recipe book, a tool that splits the bills), and the public ones you've been meaning to make (the plumbing business, the band, the bake sale).

Changing a site is just asking again. Every change is saved, so you can roll back to any earlier version instantly. Forms and RSVPs land in your email. Public sites can use your own web address, and it's free to start.

payload.name: Synthesia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Synthesia turns whatever you're working on into a finished, on-brand video.

Start from a prompt, a script, a document, or a link. We build a multi-scene video draft using your workspace's brand kits or one our curated Styles. Choose your Style or brand kit in the chat, open the draft in Synthesia to edit, or just generate and watch the video directly in the chat.

Already have the source material somewhere else? Pull it from the tools you're connected to and hand it straight to us — no copy-paste, no rebuilding.

You can ask Synthesia to:

"Make a video explaining our new expense policy."
"Turn this brief into a two-minute video for new starters."
"Take the notes from our product spec and make an internal launch video."
"Pull this quarter's numbers and make a 90-second update for the team."
"Find the onboarding video we published last quarter."
"Summarize what shipped this week and turn it into a video for the sales team."
"Show me my drafts."

Requirements: a paid Synthesia account. Connect once and we'll use your existing brand settings and workspace permissions — you'll only ever see videos you already have access to in Synthesia.

Want to go hands-on? Every draft or generated video can be opened in Synthesia's full editor for editing and polish.

This plugin is currently in beta and features may be added or removed in the future, and there may be bugs. Please report any bugs, feedback, or issues you experience at https://synthesiacreate.typeform.com/mcp-beta and/or support@synthesia.io

payload.name: Proposal.Biz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create professional, beautifully designed business documents from a single prompt in under 60 seconds. Just describe what you need and let AI do the rest.

payload.name: Sequencer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sequencer helps users plan video projects, generate image, video, and audio assets, edit scenes and timelines, review cuts, and export finished videos through ChatGPT.

payload.name: AINSOF
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AINSOF helps filmmakers and creators find original production music, discover similar tracks from a reference, analyze video for soundtrack recommendations, preview tracks, build cue sheets, and request track delivery or licensing support.

payload.name: Embroidery File Converter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Digitize PNG, JPG, SVG, and WebP artwork into embroidery designs, or convert existing embroidery files between machine formats such as PES, DST, JEF, VP3, EXP, and more. Upload a file to create a private stitch preview, then review thread-rendered stitches, dimensions, thread colours, warnings, and production metrics in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Butter (Beta)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Butter is the video editor that lets you and your team collaborate with AI. The Butter MCP can pull in your assets and context and help you create ads with professional motion. You can continue to edit any Butter project in the browser with full manual control: change copy, move things around on canvas, retime on the timeline, and more. Use AI to help you move fast, and never lose control or quality.

payload.name: Sonilo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate fully licensed AI music, background music, sound effects, and video soundtracks from a simple prompt or a public video link. Sonilo can match audio to your video, keep speech clear, mix music or sound effects into a new video, and automatically lower background music under voiceovers. Use it for social videos, product demos, podcasts, ads, games, presentations, and more.

payload.name: ShotClick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ShotClick is a screenplay editor: professional formatting, locked scene numbers, revision passes, production breakdown, and .fdx import and export.

This plugin lets ChatGPT work inside the script itself instead of returning loose text. It reads your projects, scenes, subject, treatment, outline, characters, research notes and comments, and writes back properly formatted scenes, loglines, treatments and outline beats. Your existing permissions apply: on a shared project, a viewer stays read-only through the plugin too.

It can open a "what if" branch from any scene, so an alternate version of the story is written in parallel without touching the original. It also reaches AI Studio, the screenplay-to-video pipeline: it looks at the generated keyframes and reference images, then writes the image and video prompts that match them.

No tool deletes anything — not a scene, not a project, not a note — and no tool spends AI credits. Connecting requires a ShotClick account on the Studio plan, which includes the MCP connector.

payload.name: Clueso
payload.description: Edit or create video by prompt
payload.summaryOriginal: Edit or create video by prompt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.

What Chatgpt can do with it:
• Create - build a project from a prompt, a screen recording, a slide deck, or a document
• Compose - place text, callouts, shapes, images, motion graphics and stock footage across a timeline
• Narrate - write scripts and generate voiceover from a library of 350+ voices, synced to on-screen action
• Edit - make targeted changes to any clip, element or word without rebuilding the project
• Preview - render any frame as an image to check the result mid-conversation
• Publish - export the finished video, and build the written article from the same source
• Reuse - save any project as a template so the next video inherits its structure and branding

Because it runs through your assistant, it composes with whatever else you have connected pull a script from meeting notes, a feature list from a project tracker, or account detail from a CRM, and build the video from material that already exists.

Typical uses: product and feature walkthroughs, customer education libraries, internal training built from existing decks, launch and changelog videos, help-centre articles paired with video.

Everything the connector creates opens in the Clueso editor and stays fully editable.

payload.name: Quickads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QuickAds helps you research successful ads, discover trending hooks, and turn insights into new campaigns. Create AI images and videos, publish posts, launch ad campaigns, run automated agents, and analyze the performance of your content, ads, and ad accounts - all from one place.
